notes:
Changes since 0.1.0-beta.12.

### Added

- Ad scripts have a running total, a target length of 15, 30, 60, or custom seconds, and a meter showing how far the script runs over or under. Set a default length for silent beats and correct invalid durations directly in the affected cell.
- Start an ad script with a TV spot, social video, or audio-only radio preset. Open column settings from the heading, drag headings to reorder columns, and resize them from their edges. Visual or Audio can be hidden while at least one writing column remains visible.
- Move beats by dragging their gutter or using Alt+Up/Down. Duplicate with Ctrl+D, add below with Ctrl+Enter, and add above with Ctrl+Shift+Enter. On macOS, use Command for the Ctrl shortcuts.
- Delivery presets help prepare a screenplay Reader PDF or editable Final Draft file, an article Client review DOCX or Article handoff ZIP, and a compiled Editor manuscript or Query sample DOCX. Query samples omit the contents page and word counts.
- Review included media and external links before exporting. Leave optional attachments out of an article handoff without removing them from the draft, and resolve unavailable images before saving.
- MCP contract v4 adds paginated document listings, scoped search, project summaries, document outlines, bounded text reads, and targeted text edits. Connected agents can discover tools before Stela starts and reconnect when the app becomes available.

### Improved

- Ad-script beats fit their content with growing text fields, pinned column headings, an active-beat marker, and larger reference-image thumbnails. Image actions and direction text open from compact menus; beat deletion asks for confirmation inside Stela.
- Ad-script Undo groups continuous typing into useful steps and restores the caret to the edited position. Ad-script and screenplay menus include Cut, Copy, and Paste.

### Fixed

- Agent reads scale to larger projects, search yields between batches, and list/search cursors remain valid when existing documents are edited. Read results use workspace-relative identifiers instead of stored absolute paths.
- The MCP helper reports connection and timeout errors clearly, retries a failed connection once, and exits when a Windows update needs to replace it. Settings reports listener startup failures.

### Compatibility and installation notes

- Radio presets can hide the Visual column. Older betas cannot open ad scripts saved in that layout; back up your workspace before upgrading and update collaborators before sharing these files.
- Reconnect MCP clients after updating so they discover contract v4 and its revised tool arguments. Existing workspace grants and connection settings remain in place.
- Final Draft support is editable screenplay interchange. Use Final Draft for production revisions and exact production pagination, and review compatibility notes when importing or exporting.
- Beta.7 and later can update through Settings → Updates once this release is published. Earlier betas require one manual install. Beta and stable update channels remain separate.

### Security maintenance

- Update bundled diagram, validation, authentication, and routing libraries, cloud dependencies, and frontend build tools to address known dependency advisories.
- Update the native Tauri framework and plugins, MCP SDK, ZIP handling, and Rust runtime dependencies. Keep the JavaScript Tauri companions aligned with their Rust versions.
